concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a single square app icon concept for SAFE KOREA, an independent Korean emergency preparedness app. Direction A: confident modern protection. Full bleed deep ink navy background (#17352D). One very bold ivory rounded shield silhouette centered, with an elegant warm coral negative-space open doorway or forward aperture cut into it, no house roof. Sophisticated flat geometric design with just a restrained soft material depth, no shiny bevels. Icon occupies central 65 percent with generous adaptive mask safe area. Extremely simple recognizable at 48px. No lettering, no numbers, no check mark, no medical red cross, no official seal, no government insignia, no flag, no border, no rounded outer corners, no phone mockup, no multiple concepts. This is a brand proposal, not a safety certification.

Use case: logo-brand. Create a single square app icon concept for SAFE KOREA, an independent Korean emergency preparedness app. Direction B: calm intuitive direction and preparedness. Full bleed soft warm ivory background. Center one bold deep forest green (#086B50) abstract folded ribbon, combining an open circular shelter embrace and a simple forward/upward directional notch. Dynamic asymmetrical contemporary geometric monogram-like symbol but no literal letters, no recognizable existing logos. Clean large shapes and ample negative space, soft tiny sage-green accent only. Premium flat editorial brand mark, not map pin clipart and not a house. Readable at 48px, centered within 65 percent safe area. No text, no check mark, no medical cross, no official emblem, no flag, no gradient background, no outer rounded corners, no mockup, no multi-icon grid.

Use case: logo-brand. Create a single square app icon concept for SAFE KOREA, an independent Korean preparedness app. Direction C: memorable warm companion. A bold simplified white Korean Jindo dog head with upright triangular ears, dark forest green tiny oval eyes and small nose, calm kind confident expression, slightly rounded cheeks, and a simple forest green scarf visible at bottom. Face-forward, head only, no human hands or body, no accessories or badges. Full bleed warm golden ochre background. Crisp premium flat illustration, no realistic fur, no plush 3D rendering, no tiny details, just strong recognizable silhouette and minimal two-tone shadows. Maintain comfortable space around ears and chin within central 70 percent for adaptive masks. No lettering, no government/police/medical symbols, no red cross, no outer rounded corners or frames, no phone mockups, no grid. Friendly to adults and families, not babyish.
